scope: Actual landspeed, hyperspace, landing and takeoff actions: costs, intermediate movement results, carrier/crew usage and operational power. Starfighter deployment excludes ordinary exterior sites even though landing there is allowed.
method: Locations, Force and Light Y-wing/Han are controlled fixtures. Dark vessel and crew deployment uses the prior actual-deployment helper.
All eight movement observations use actual GEMP legal actions; production sources unchanged.
Native comparison identifies the Tatooine endpoint by canonical title: native uses Light 1_127, GEMP uses Dark 1_289. No equivalence of their different Force icons or unrelated text is claimed.
Native comparisons pass through response windows with JSON recovery; intermediate landspeed results match GEMP initial/completed flags.
limitations: Sector/mobile-system movement, shuttling, broader astromech/modifier/prevention providers and full card coverage remain.
Docking transit vehicle integration, CPU heuristics and browser recovery are native checks outside this reference harness.
